contract: Six physical and nuisance parameters in the original normalized parameter space. Fixed symmetric Gaussian proposal, original prior and observed density, per-proposal combined finite gate. Four local Metropolis trials, one independently initialized wider trial, and two separate quadratic-emitter resolution comparisons. Every synthesized trial rebuilds both stellar fields and the eclipse packets.
